'''Pietro Boselli''' (born 3 December 1988) is an [[Italians|Italian]] [[Model (person)|model]], [[engineer]], and former mathematics [[Postgraduate education|postgraduate]] [[teacher]] at [[University College London|University College London.]] He completed his PhD in November 2014 in the Department of Engineering, on the topic of "An Inverse Design Methodology  for Long Last-Stage Steam  Turbine Blades."<ref name=":4" />

==Biography==
Pietro, the eldest of four brothers, was born in [[Negrar di Valpolicella|Negrar]], [[Province of Verona|Verona]], but was raised in [[Brescia]], which he considers his hometown.<ref name="graz">{{cite news |last1=Beaty |first1=Zoe |date=12 May 2015 |title=The Nation's 'Hottest Maths Teacher': 'I'm Too Good-looking To Be Taken Seriously' |url=http://lifestyle.one/grazia/fashion/shopping/nations-hottest-maths-teacher-pietro-boselli/ |url-status=live |archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20160311042721/http://lifestyle.one/grazia/fashion/shopping/nations-hottest-maths-teacher-pietro-boselli/ |archivedate=11 March 2016 |accessdate=2 March 2016 |work=[[Grazia]]}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |last=Benasseni |first=Marco |date=2023-08-03 |title=Il top influencer Pietro Boselli in Maniva con la sua motocicletta |url=https://www.bresciaoggi.it/argomenti/spettacoli/spettacoli/il-top-influencer-pietro-boselli-in-maniva-con-la-sua-motocicletta-1.10210957 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240306195113/https://www.bresciaoggi.it/argomenti/spettacoli/spettacoli/il-top-influencer-pietro-boselli-in-maniva-con-la-sua-motocicletta-1.10210957 |archive-date=2024-03-06 |access-date=2024-03-29 |website=Bresciaoggi.it |language=it}}</ref> When he was 6 years old, he was discovered by an agent, and began his modelling career with [[Armani |url=https://www.wmagazine.com/gallery/pietro-boselli-armani-model-worlds-hottest-math-teacher |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20170418060341/http://www.wmagazine.com/gallery/pietro-boselli-armani-model-worlds-hottest-math-teacher |archive-date=2017-04-18 |access-date=2024-03-29 |website=[[W Magazine]] |language=en}}</ref> He completed his [[Secondary education in Italy|secondary education]] at [[Liceo scientifico|Liceo Scientifico]] Statale Annibale Calini in 2007.<ref>{{Cite web |last=Boselli |first=Pietro |date=2011-03-02 |title=La vera sostanza dell'insegnare |url=https://www.bresciaoggi.it/spazio-lettori/lettere/la-vera-sostanza-dell-39-insegnare-1.4350572 |website=Bresciaoggi.it |language=it}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |last=Troncana |first=Alessandra |date=2015-06-09 |title=Muscoli (e cervello) in passerella |url=http://brescia.corriere.it/notizie/cronaca/15_giugno_09/muscoli-cervello-passerella-pietro-boselli-modello-brescia-calini-a8ac6750-0e85-11e5-89f7-3e9b1062ea42.shtml |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240329202450/https://brescia.corriere.it/notizie/cronaca/15_giugno_09/muscoli-cervello-passerella-pietro-boselli-modello-brescia-calini-a8ac6750-0e85-11e5-89f7-3e9b1062ea42.shtml |archive-date=2024-03-29 |access-date=2024-03-29 |website=Corriere della Sera |language=it}}</ref> 

He subsequently relocated to [[London]] at the age of 18 to pursue studies in [[mechanical engineering]] at [[University College London]] (UCL). He graduated with a [[first-class honours|first-class]] degree ([[Bachelor of Engineering|BEng]]) in 2010 and obtained a [[Doctor of Philosophy|PhD]] in [[computational fluid dynamics]] in 2016.<ref>{{Cite web |last=Tharrett |first=Matthew |date=2015-08-25 |title=Hot Teacher Pietro Boselli Talks Computational Fluid Dynamics In His Underwear |url=https://www.logotv.com/news/obsmfx/hot-teacher-pietro-boselli-talks-computational-fluid-dynamics-in-his-underwear |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220812183548/https://www.logotv.com/news/obsmfx/hot-teacher-pietro-boselli-talks-computational-fluid-dynamics-in-his-underwear |archive-date=2022-08-12 |access-date=2024-03-29 |website=[[Logo TV]] |language=en-us}}</ref><ref name=":4">{{Cite thesis |title=An inverse design methodology for long last-stage steam turbine blades |url=https://discovery.ucl.ac.uk/id/eprint/1508258/ |publisher=UCL (University College London) |date=2016-08-28 |degree=Doctoral |first=P. |last=Boselli}}</ref>  During his doctoral studies, he served as a [[Teaching assistant (United Kingdom)|teaching assistant]] from September 2010 to June 2013, a [[lecturer]] from September 2013 to June 2014, and a [[visiting lecturer]] from October 2014 to March 2015 at UCL.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Pietro Boselli - PETRA DESIGN LTD |url=https://uk.linkedin.com/in/pietro-boselli-82ba3583 |access-date=2024-03-29 |website=[[LinkedIn]] |language=en}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |date=31 March 2015 |title=From maths to modelling: Teacher surprises his students |url=https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/newsbeat-32128127 |url-status=live |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20150425143536/http://www.bbc.co.uk/newsbeat/article/32128127/from-maths-to-modelling-teacher-surprises-his-students |archive-date=25 April 2015 |access-date=11 June 2015 |publisher=[[Newsbeat]]}}</ref>

In 2015, a [[Facebook]] post from 2014 by one of his students, which mentioned that he was also a successful model, went viral.<ref>{{Cite web |date=2015-03-27 |title=London College Students Discover That Their Math Lecturer Is Hunky Male Model |url=https://instinctmagazine.com/post/london-college-students-discover-their-math-lecturer-hunky-male-model |url-status=dead |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20150328185007/https://instinctmagazine.com/post/london-college-students-discover-their-math-lecturer-hunky-male-model |archive-date=2015-03-28 |website=[[Instinct (magazine)|Instinct]]}}</ref><ref name=":1">{{Cite web |date=2015-03-30 |title=Man Who Works Two Jobs To Earn A Living Makes The News |url=https://www.huffingtonpost.co.uk/2015/03/30/ucl-lecturer-pietro-boselli-is-top-male-model_n_6969222.html |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20150402062824/https://www.huffingtonpost.co.uk/2015/03/30/ucl-lecturer-pietro-boselli-is-top-male-model_n_6969222.html |archive-date=2015-04-02 |access-date=2024-03-29 |website=[[HuffPost|HuffPost UK]] |language=en}}</ref><ref>{{cite news |date=30 January 2015 |title=【红领巾采访】揭秘那枚UCL颜值爆表的"数学老师" |url=http://www.honglingjin.co.uk/115217.html |url-status=live |archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20150817072601/http://www.honglingjin.co.uk/115217.html |archivedate=17 August 2015 |accessdate=31 July 2015 |work=[[Red Scarf (company)|RED SCARF 英国红领巾]]}}</ref>  In response to his rising prominence, Boselli has expressed appreciation but has also publicly opposed the 'dumb model' [[stereotype]] and similar [[Prejudice|prejudices]] on multiple occasions.<ref name="graz" /><ref>{{cite web |title=Pietro Boselli Experiences Male Objectification - UK Models |url=http://www.ukmodels.co.uk/pietro-boselli-experiences-male-objectification/ |url-status=live |archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20150908112017/http://www.ukmodels.co.uk/pietro-boselli-experiences-male-objectification/ |archivedate=8 September 2015 |accessdate=27 October 2015}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |last=Lynch |first=Alison |date=2015-04-21 |title=World's hottest maths teacher tried to keep modelling career secret. Oops |url=https://metro.co.uk/2015/04/21/worlds-hottest-maths-teacher-says-he-tried-to-keep-his-modelling-career-a-secret-from-students-5159221/ |access-date=2024-03-29 |website=Metro |language=en}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |last=Vesey-Byrne |first=Joe |date=2016-12-14 |title=The 'world's hottest maths teacher' is fighting the 'dumb model' myth |url=https://www.indy100.com/viral/world-hot-maths-teacher-pietro-boselli-dumb-model-myth-intelligence-7474101 |access-date=2024-03-29 |website=[[The Independent#Indy100|Indy100]] |language=en}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |last=Arias |first=Jacqueline |date=2017-03-13 |title=Pietro Boselli Wants You to Stop Viewing Smart People as Boring |url=https://preen.ph/42256/pietro-boselli-wants-you-to-stop-viewing-smart-people-as-boring |access-date=2024-03-29 |website=Preen.ph |language=en-US}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |last=Philippine Tatler |date=2017-07-12 |title=Pietro Boselli: Body & Soul |url=https://www.tatlerasia.com/style/fashion/pietro-boselli-body-soul |access-date=2024-03-29 |website=[[Tatler]] [[Edipresse|Asia]] |language=en}}</ref>

In subsequent years, Boselli expanded his presence across various social media platforms, including [[Instagram]], [[Facebook]], [[Twitter|X]], [[TikTok]], and [[YouTube]], as well as subscription-based channels.<ref name=":5">{{Cite book |last=Mercer |first=John |url=https://www.taylorfrancis.com/books/9781351256285 |title=Sexualised Masculinity: Men’s Bodies in 21st Century Media Culture |last2=Smith |first2=Clarissa |date=2025-01-06 |publisher=Routledge |isbn=978-1-351-25628-5 |edition=1 |location=London |language=en |doi=10.4324/9781351256285}}</ref> He characterizes his content as advocating for fitness, the symbiotic relationship between body and mind, and philosophical discourse.<ref name=":6">{{Cite web|title='At the Edge of Life' With Pietro Boselli|url=https://www.palladiummag.com/2023/06/07/at-the-edge-of-life-with-pietro-boselli/|date=2023-06-07|access-date=2026-01-25|language=en-US|first=Matt|last=Ellison}}</ref> Furthermore, Boselli remains faithful to his Italian heritage and scientific background in his content, promoting Mediterranean cuisine and employing scientific reasoning.<ref name=":6" /> This combination, together with Boselli|url=https://www.pietroboselli.com/|website=Pietro Boselli|access-date=2026-01-25|language=en-US}}</ref> Consequently, he can be considered a mega social media influencer.<ref>{{Cite journal|title=Micro, macro and mega-influencers on instagram: The power of persuasion via the parasocial relationship|journal=Journal of Business to and engage an audience that is not solely attracted by a [[Masculinity|masculine physique]] but also appreciates [[intellectual]] engagement.<ref name=":5" /> 

== Modeling ==
Boselli is represented by British [[Modeling agency|modelling agency]] Models 1.<ref>{{Cite web |date=2013-08-15 |title=Pietro Boselli {{!}}{{!}} FTAPE {{!}}{{!}} Models Wall – Models 1 Blog |url=https://models1blog.com/pietro-boselli-ftape-models-wall/ |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20221209055638/https://models1blog.com/pietro-boselli-ftape-models-wall/ |archive-date=2022-12-09 |access-date=2024-03-29 |language=en-US}}</ref> In 2014, he won first place at the World Beauty Fitness & Fashion (WBFF) European ProAm event in the fitness model category.<ref name=":1" /> He has appeared in [[American (word)|American]] modeling campaigns for clothing retailer [[Abercrombie & Fitch]] and fitness club [[Equinox Fitness|Equinox]],<ref name=":0" /> as well as for the fashion house [[Moschino]] and [[Vogue (magazine)|''Vogue'']] magazine. He has also appeared in spreads for ''[[GQ Style]]'' and has been featured on the cover of ''[[Attitude (magazine)|Attitude]]''.<ref>{{Cite web |last=Hansen-Bundy |first=Benjy |date=2016-12-21 |title=Workout Tricks and Gym Style Tips That'll Help You Look as Good as This Guy |url=https://www.gq.com/story/pietro-boselli-workout-style-tips |access-date=2024-03-29 |website=[[GQ]] |language=en-US}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |last=Stroude |first=Will |date=2017-09-07 |title=Maths teacher-turned-model Pietro Boselli is Attitude's new cover guy |url=https://www.attitude.co.uk/news/world/maths-teacher-turned-model-pietro-boselli-is-attitudes-new-cover-guy-284730/ |access-date=2024-03-29 |website=[[Attitude (magazine)|Attitude]] |language=en-GB}}</ref>

In 2016, he was signed by [[Armani]] for their EA7 campaign.<ref name=":2">{{Cite web |last=Maoui |first=Zak |date=2016-03-29 |title=World's hottest maths teacher Pietro Boselli becomes Armani model |url=https://www.gq-magazine.co.uk/article/maths-teacher-becomes-armani-model |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160330001515/http://www.gq-magazine.co.uk/article/maths-teacher-becomes-armani-model |archive-date=2016-03-30 |access-date=2024-03-29 |website=[[GQ|British GQ]] |language=en-GB}}</ref><ref name=":3">{{Cite web |last=Willett-Wei |first=Megan |date=2016-03-26 |title=The 'world's hottest math teacher' has a PhD in engineering and models for Armani |url=https://www.businessinsider.com/hottest-math-teacher-pietro-boselli-2016-3 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20161010145415/http://www.businessinsider.com/hottest-math-teacher-pietro-boselli-2016-3 |archive-date=2016-10-10 |access-date=2024-03-29 |website=[[Business Insider]] |language=en-US}}</ref> In the same year, he founded [[sportswear]] brand Petra Design.<ref>{{Cite web |last=Wells |first=Jonathan |title=Pietro Boselli introduces sporting fashion brand Petra |url=https://www.thegentlemansjournal.com/article/pietro-boselli-sportswear-petra-interview/ |access-date=2024-03-29 |website=The Gentleman's Journal |language=en}}</ref> In August 2020, he was featured on a [[Lenticular printing|lenticular cover]] of ''GQ Italia'', which alternated between his image and an image of [[David (Michelangelo)|Michelangelo's David]]. The magazine was successfully sued by the [[Galleria dell'Accademia]], which holds the image rights to the statue, for using a photograph of the statue without their permission.<ref name="Bandara">{{cite news |last=Bandara |first=Pesala |date=5 June 2023 |title=Museum Wins Lawsuit Over Photo of Michelangelo's David |url=https://petapixel.com/2023/06/05/museum-wins-lawsuit-over-photo-of-500-year-old-sculpture-of-david/ |access-date=6 June 2023 |work=[[PetaPixel]]}}</ref>
